notes: Non-runtime registry for every declared_write_set field in the AppState transition, action, and event coverage registries.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only during an allowed panel-routing or volume/menu transition commit.
invariant_checks: Active panel changes must preserve inactive panel-local records.
Panel routing must resolve to an existing YtreePanel carrier before render projection.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through command start/completion/cancel transitions.
invariant_checks: Command completion must not mutate panel or volume fields outside the declared follow-up transition.
Command failure or cancellation must preserve authoritative panel and volume state.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through transitions that declare user-visible outcome or constraint messaging.
invariant_checks: Blocked transitions may write message state only when needed for outcome clarity.
Message writes must not imply filesystem or panel state success.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only when entering, completing, or dismissing a registered modal transition.
invariant_checks: Modal dismissal must leave underlying panel and volume authority unchanged unless declared.
Destructive confirmations must remain explicit and default-safe.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May be queued only by transitions that declare a deterministic follow-up boundary.
invariant_checks: Pending transitions must name a registered transition before later mutation.
Queueing a transition must not advance panel or volume generations by itself.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through volume lifecycle transitions that validate panel bindings.
invariant_checks: Releasing a volume must not leave active or inactive panels with stale volume pointers.
Volume registry changes must rebind affected panels through stable identity or deterministic fallback.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only during resize/reflow transitions executed in the main loop.
invariant_checks: Resize handling must not choose a new authoritative selection from rendered rows.
Layout changes alone must not advance volume_generation.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only when a transition marks or clears declared projection surfaces.
invariant_checks: Render invalidation writes must not mutate selection, focus, or identity state.
Render projection may clear only surfaces produced from settled AppState records.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only during main-loop layout/reflow or render projection setup.
invariant_checks: Ncurses window recreation must happen outside signal handlers.
Window handles must not become restore authority for panel selection or viewport state.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only for the targeted panel through navigation, restore, or rebind transitions.
invariant_checks: File selection identity must be path/name based, not a stale FileEntry pointer.
Inactive panel file selection must remain frozen across active-only actions.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only for the targeted panel when navigation, bounds correction, or reflow declares it.
invariant_checks: File viewport correction must preserve the stored selection when it remains visible.
Render paths may compute temporary file projection without overwriting this origin.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only during allowed focus, modal restore, split, or file/tree transition commits.
invariant_checks: Reactivation must restore the recorded tree/small-file/big-file shape directly.
Focus shape changes must not import the inactive panel's state.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May increment only when panel-local restore authority changes.
invariant_checks: Render projection alone must not advance panel_generation.
Snapshot restore must compare panel_generation before applying saved state.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through snapshot capture, rebind, fallback, or volume-binding transitions.
invariant_checks: Restore snapshots must use stable identities plus generation validation.
Stale snapshots must fail closed through the deterministic fallback order.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only for the targeted panel during tree navigation or rebind/fallback transitions.
invariant_checks: Tree cursor position is interpreted against visible rows, not raw topology indices.
Inactive panel cursor must remain unchanged unless the transition explicitly targets that panel.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through tree navigation, restore, or topology rebind transitions for the targeted panel.
invariant_checks: Tree selection identity must be stable and path based within the current volume namespace.
Selection restore must not derive authority from disp_begin_pos plus cursor_pos.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only when navigation, bounds correction, resize, or rebind declares viewport mutation.
invariant_checks: Hidden dotfile visibility must not cause extra viewport shifts when selection remains visible.
Render-side temporary placement must not overwrite the saved viewport origin.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through volume selection, cycle, release, or restore transitions.
invariant_checks: Panel volume binding must point to an existing volume/archive namespace or deterministic fallback.
A panel must not import the opposite panel's volume-specific snapshot.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through logging, rebuild, refresh, release, or completed filesystem mutation transitions.
invariant_checks: Shared topology changes must re-anchor each panel by its own stable identity.
Topology mutation must advance volume_generation before restore consumers observe it.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through explicit log, relog, release, collapse, refresh, or rebuild transitions.
invariant_checks: Logged state is shared topology and must not store panel-local cursor or tag authority.
Unlogged placeholders must not degrade a frozen file-view anchor without rebind or payload reload.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May change only through payload load, refresh, archive, or completed filesystem mutation transitions.
invariant_checks: Payload cache changes must not overwrite panel-local file selection identity.
Mutation-result commits must distinguish filesystem side effects from AppState metadata updates.

owner_fields.mutation_rule: May increment only when shared topology, payload identity, logged state, or namespace mapping changes.
invariant_checks: Render projection alone must not advance volume_generation.
Generation mismatch must force stable-identity re-resolution before snapshot restore.
